# China Daily

> > China's leading English-language news organization providing comprehensive coverage of sports, international affairs, culture, and global perspectives.

China Daily (中国日报) offers extensive sports coverage including soccer (UEFA Champions League, Bayern, Paris Saint-Germain), Olympics, basketball, and volleyball, alongside international news from the UK (英国), US (美国), Germany, Brazil, and beyond. The site features special topic coverage, photo galleries, and global commentary blogs.

## Key Topics

- China Daily (中国日报)
- International Sports Coverage
- UEFA Champions League
- Olympics & Major Games
- UK (英国) & US (美国) News
- Germany, Brazil, Cuba Relations
- Soccer (Bayern, Paris Saint-Germain, Guo'an)
- Basketball & NBA
- IAAF Athletics
- Volleyball & FIVB
- Ice Hockey & NHL
- Special Coverage Topics
- China Culture & Photos
- Global Commentary

## Core Sports Coverage

- [Sport News - Headlines, Stars, Photos - China Daily](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/index.html): Main sports section with soccer, basketball, tennis, Olympics coverage
- [Volleyball - Sports - Chinadaily.com.cn](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/volleyball.html): Volleyball news covering FIVB tournaments and Asian championships
- [Hockey - Sports - Chinadaily.com.cn](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/node_1133761.htm): Ice hockey news featuring Beijing Kunlun Red Star and Continental League
- [IAAF World Championships - chinadaily.com.cn](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/IAAF-World-Championships.html): IAAF World Championships track and field athletics coverage
- [Hot words by games - Sports - Chinadaily.com.cn](http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/node_1131321.htm): Sports games highlights with Bayern, Paris Saint-Germain coverage
